constant.definition: full-period mean of the exchange-loss profile
constant.open_reason: The source volume has revoked this center outright as a fitting artifact of a mis-set period, not as a constant with a corrected value, so there is nothing here left to compute. Retiring the entry would have to drop Values.deltaMean and deltaMean_neg from a frozen module, which Reattest forbids; the entry therefore stays and records the revocation.
